item.title: Webinar: 3 Mistakes Master’s Students Make on LinkedIn
item.description: Date: Wednesday, October 21, 2026 2:00 PM - 2:30 PM - Are you finding it difficult to use LinkedIn in your job search? Not sure how to engage with employers, grow your network, or reach out to people without making your outreach feel one-sided or transactional? Join Beyond Graduate School for this webinar where we’ll explore how you can use LinkedIn effectively as part of your job search. We’ll discuss the 3 most common mistakes master’s students make when using LinkedIn, and what to do instead.

item.title: Add Business Skills and Expand Your Opportunities: An Accelerated Master’s at Lally with Credit Sharing
item.description: Complete your master’s and rise into leadership faster. Lally is the only school at RPI where 6 undergraduate credits also count toward your master’s, so most students complete the degree in two extra semesters or less. Engineers, scientists, and students from every major can add business, analytics, finance, supply chain, and management skills that expand career opportunities and leadership capabilities. Join an info session October 6 or 20, 4-5 p.m., Lally Hall 104. Snacks provided!

item.title: Quantum Optimization for Feature Selection in Biomedical Data Online Workshop
item.description: Henry Liu of RPI will present research on feature selection for autism spectrum disorder (ASD) metabolomics data on Wednesday, 10/21/26 from 10:00 - 11:30 am. The work uses a QUBO formulation and quantum optimization to identify a small set of informative biomarkers from a rapidly growing space of possible feature combinations. For more information and link to join the workshop, please visit https://foci.rpi.edu/news-and-events

item.title: Computer Science Colloquia - Sepehr Assadi - Too Big To Store: Two Decades of Graph Streaming
item.description: Date: Monday, October 19, 2026 4:00 PM - 5:00 PM - Many of today’s graphs are too large to store using traditional means. Graph streaming offers a simple model for such settings: the edges of a graph arrive one by one, and an algorithm must process them on the fly using memory much smaller than the input. Over the past twenty years, this model has become a rich meeting point. In this talk, I will give an overview of the area: what can and cannot be done in this model and why, and along the way…

item.title: Certifications & Skill Development in Percipio
item.description:
This course introduces the tools available in Percipio to support growth through certifications and skill benchmarks. You’ll learn how to identify relevant certifications and use benchmark assessments to measure current knowledge. Perfect for employees and supervisors alike, this session will help you navigate the platform’s upskilling features and align learning with career development objectives.
